children: ABM Industries reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $2317.1M and diluted EPS of $0.84, each up versus the year-ago quarter, as Aviation and Mission & Defense contract wins and acquisitions offset some Business & Industry client attrition.
Revenue was $2317.1M, compared with $2224M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 4.2%.
Net income was $49.7M, compared with $41.8M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 18.9%.
Diluted EPS was $0.84, compared with $0.67 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 25.4%.
Revenue growth was driven by Aviation new wins and expansions in Mission & Defense, including semiconductor-related M&D work, and contributions from recent acquisitions.
Business & Industry experienced client attrition that reduced revenues in the quarter.
Operational efficiency efforts include a Restructuring Program targeting $35M of annualized SG&A savings; $28M of related charges were recorded year-to-date.
Systems modernization under the ELEVATE ERP and workforce tools is progressing; the company incurred go‑live costs with expected future performance improvements.
Technical Solutions saw increased energy and HVAC work, though microgrid project delays weighed on near-term project revenue.
